description: Shared Renovate preset for the WeTrade cluster ecosystem. Consumed by all workload repos via `extends: ["github>wondering-developer/renovate-config"]`. Handles three digest-pinning schemas across Helm charts + raw k8s manifests.

customManagers.description: Schema A: `image: <name>` + `imageDigest: <sha256>` across helm values.yaml. Annotation `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name> [currentValue=<tag>] [versioning=<v>]` ABOVE the imageDigest line. Comment lines, blank lines and an `imageVersion:` line may sit in between — only those; any other key ends the block so an annotation can never bind to the next image's digest. currentValue is optional — defaults to 'latest' for pure-digest tracking; set it explicitly to pin a major/minor (e.g. mariadb 10.6) so Renovate only bumps digests of that tag stream.
Schema C fallback: inline `image: <name>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>` in contexts the built-in kubernetes-manager does not scan (e.g. `values/*.yaml` outside helm/).

packageRules.description: Own-built images (sebastart/*) are pinned via CI per deploy — never Renovate's job.
Major bumps of upstream images need manual approval (not auto-PR). See dependency dashboard.

Auto-merge safe updates (digest + minor + patch + pin) once CI is green — stops PRs piling up. Majors stay gated by the dependencyDashboardApproval rule above. Honored by Mend Renovate Cloud (self-hosted CronJob retired 2026-06-02).

Pre-1.0 (0.x) images: under semver a minor bump (0.3 -> 0.5) is classified 'minor', but for 0.x projects it is routinely BREAKING. Litestream 0.3.13 -> 0.5.12 was auto-merged as 'minor' and broke the honeypal money-DB backup (incident 2026-06-09). Require manual approval for 0.x minor bumps; digest/patch within 0.x stay auto-merged.
Group upstream digest-only updates per image — avoids PR storms when a tag gets a silent rebuild.
Helm chart upgrades (Chart.yaml / chart-versions.yaml) — one PR per chart.

`helm` and `sigstore/cosign` are picked up by the github-actions manager, but they are NOT action refs — they are tool releases passed as action *inputs* (`azure/setup-helm` `version:`, `sigstore/cosign-installer` `cosign-release:`). pinDigests tries to rewrite `v3.21.3` into a commit SHA, which the artifact updater cannot do: every repo grew a permanently failing `renovate/pin-dependencies` branch and the dashboard reported 'Error updating branch: update failure'. Version-pin them instead of digest-pinning them.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security updates bypass the schedule for every datasource. `prPriority: 10` used to be set here and in a nested packageRule — Renovate rejects it inside vulnerabilityAlerts and dropped both, so it was never in effect. Removed rather than carried along as dead config; the duplicate `matchDatasources: [docker]` packageRule that wrapped it went with it.
